trackPage.comparisonHint: Choose a signal to see where it comes from and what it can tell you.

signals.label: Observed visits
signals.title: A detected visit has a source.
signals.meaning: Recognized assistant sources can be grouped in the visit breakdown and time-series summary.
signals.limit: The browser script needs available signals. It cannot observe every non-JavaScript crawler, recover every direct visit, or prove that a visitor later bought.

signals.label: Simulated decisions
signals.title: A new scan is a new comparison.
signals.meaning: Win rate is the percentage of simulations where an agent picks your product over a competitor. Compare completed decisions after publishing a change.
signals.limit: Simulated decisions are separate from observed storefront visits and sales. Scheduled rescans are not active today.

signals.label: Estimated lift
signals.title: An estimate accompanies the fix.
signals.meaning: Lift is an estimate recorded with the listing change. It helps distinguish the expected effect of a fix from later completed tests.
signals.limit: It is not measured revenue or a completed post-publish experiment. Request a new scan to compare simulated decisions after a change.

attributionFlow: Otherwise, a recent AI referral in that store
Configured window: seven days by default
trackPage.attributionNote: A store-wide match does not establish that the same shopper made the order.
trackPage.referenceDescription: Read the collection limits, estimate definitions and account boundaries before interpreting the results.
